effect.en: For five turns, prevents all Pokémon on the ground from sleeping and strengthens their Electric moves to 1.5× their power.

flavor.ko: 5턴 동안 일렉트릭필드로 만든다. 땅에 있는 포켓몬은 잠들지 않는다. 전기타입의 위력이 올라간다.
flavor.en: The user turns the ground into Electric Terrain for five turns, powering up Electric-type moves. Pokémon on the ground can no longer fall asleep.
